# /crav1-tighten-plan

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a spec to a plan](../../from-spec-to-plan.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-tighten-plan/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Walk plan.md/tasks.md issues one by one (including [`/crav1-review-plan`](crav1-review-plan.md) P#s).

1.202.0: `reviewed --items <file>` writes the open count the script computes. A hand-counted `--open` is not the path.

1.180.0: with no plan issue left, Run next names [`/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build`](crav1-tasks-ready-to-build.md) <slug>`, never [`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md); uncommitted files come first inside Run next as `Commit the <n> changed spec files:` above [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md).

1.176.0: the empty queue ends with a Run next entry, its label above the command, no `Next:` line. A spec finding already patched, dropped or kept no longer sends you back to [`/crav1-tighten-spec`](crav1-tighten-spec.md).

1.159.0: the index (remaining `P#` titles, the current one marked, plan or spec), the finding counts, the dependency waves and ordering problems, the batch card with its findings table, the one empty-queue `Next` line and the `Reviewed:` line come from `scripts/plan_check.py` (`order`, `queue`, `batch`, `reviewed`), a thin copy of the script that ships with [`/crav1-plan-from-spec`](crav1-plan-from-spec.md). The skill prints its output as-is. The typical plan shapes, the empty-queue rules, the Reviewed line, the items file and the suggest step moved word for word to `references/issues.md`.

One plan issue at a time; patches plan/tasks only (spec findings go to tighten-spec)

1.130.0: the batch is one card. `yes (Recommended)` applies every recommendation. Typed changes go on that card's free-text answer, for example `P1 A, P3 keep`. An item not mentioned keeps its recommendation. There is no Edits option.

1.145.0: the batch card is asked only after a findings table in that same reply (Id, Issue, Options, Recommendation). The card names each item, for example `P4 tasks miss the 400 path: add a test`. It does not say `table above`. The command is `<interpreter> -X utf8 <skill crav1-tighten-plan>/scripts/batch_offer.py --title "Tighten-plan batch" --items <file>`. It prints no card without rows.

1.151.0: a task listed in `claims.md` as `In progress:` is left unchanged: no renumber, reorder, rewrite, or removal. After writing `tasks.md`, the step preserves those lines and says once which claimed tasks were kept.

1.161.0: `plan_check.py order` also lists branches that wait for each other as a `Branch loop:` line with the fixes the ready check offers, in the same plain words. Each is a candidate `P#` with the new `fix-loop` option. The batch yes applies it with `walk_progress.py fix-loop --root <spec-folder> --pick <n> --yes`, which writes the `(map:)` marks or drops the one wait in `tasks.md` and rebuilds `build-map.md`.

1.201.1: a task line that says `after PR 87 merges` and has no `(after: PR 87)` is a candidate `P#`. On yes, `plan_check.py after-pr --root <spec-folder> --yes` writes the mark.

## Runs when

Plan findings, or mushy tasks. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 1 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Plan, tasks, spec, and those findings.

Reads `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `spec.md`, `claims.md` when it exists, and plan-review findings already in the chat.

## Writes

In short: The picked issue in `plan.md` or `tasks.md`.

Writes only the picked plan issue in `plan.md` or `tasks.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md` and application code alone. Leaves a claimed `In progress:` task line in `tasks.md` unchanged.

Limits and exceptions: a spec-tagged finding is not patched here.
